race.description: Happy 80th Birthday David Daking Mdn Plate
race.comment: DREAM RIOT (3) won a trial prior to finishing second here on debut 3 weeks ago, where acting up in the barriers did him no favours. He will naturally improve from that effort, and with the aid of the pole position, he can take this out. OUT OF WORDS (1) raced handy to the pace fresh up and peaked late on his run before finishing fifth. Craig Newitt picks up the ride, and from a handy gate, he is an each-way chance this time. DAY NOR THE HOUR (2) ran out of puff fresh up and will improve quickly with that run under his belt. Stick with him. AKIYAMA (9) Stratosphere filly from Lady Writer on debut. Ran third at recent trial. Watch betting.
